subject: Annual prepay: invoice schedule, drawdown triggers & EU VAT checklist
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <ecruz@highton.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-06-10T08:12:00Z
Subject: Annual prepay — invoice schedule & drawdown triggers (Highton)

Hi Jonas / Kim,

Thanks again for the demo last week — CFO wants to move forward with an annual prepay for our committed capacity. Before legal signs off we need a clear invoice schedule and the exact drawdown trigger matrix (dates, amounts, and who signs each release). Also important for us: EU VAT handling — we need to model whether Redwood will issue standard VAT invoices or support reverse-charge (we're UK/EU mix).

Attached: Highton_Invoice_Matrix_v1.xlsx and sample PO (Highton_PO_12345.pdf).

Can you confirm:
- A proposed invoice schedule (dates + amounts) that aligns with our internal fiscal quarters
- Whether Redwood can provide VAT evidence (registered VAT id on invoices) and whether you can accept monthly drawdown requests from our escrow account
- Any required docs for EU tax teams (certificate of business status, etc.)

Goal: get invoice schedule & contract redlines ready by 20 June so our procurement can sign.

Appreciate a short bullets response — CFO is on a tight deadline.

Best,
Elena
Finance Director
Highton Analytics

Attachments: Highton_Invoice_Matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Highton_PO_12345.pdf (PDF)

From: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Cruz <ecruz@highton.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-06-11T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — invoice schedule & drawdown triggers (Highton)

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear notes and the PO. Summary / proposal below so procurement has something to review quickly: 

1) Invoice schedule (proposed):
   - 2028-07-01: 40% upfront (invoice 001)
   - 2028-10-01: 30% tranche (invoice 002)
   - 2029-01-01: 30% tranche (invoice 003)
   Notes: each tranche will include a schedule of amortization for monthly usage. We can also offer a 6-month stagger if you prefer smoother cashflow.

2) Drawdown triggers / mechanics:
   - Highton will initiate monthly drawdown requests from escrow to cover actual monthly usage credited against the prepay pool.
   - Redwood will provide a drawdown confirmation file within 24 hours of payment and a monthly reconciliation CSV.

3) VAT handling (EU):
   - Redwood can issue standard VAT invoices with our EU VAT registration on invoice header, or, if reverse-charge applies, we can include required EU fields and the customer VAT number.
   - We will need a VAT registration certificate and your VAT IDs for each entity so our tax team can pick correct invoice flow.

Action items / timeline:
- Kimberly: prepare two invoice templates (standard VAT and reverse-charge) + sample invoice numbers.
- Marissa: set up a drawdown spreadsheet/dashboard we can share with your finance team (monthly reconciliation + tokenized ledger).
- Jonas (me): confirm SLA for recon and DocuSign envelope for the MAP/MAA (to be sent by 15 June).

We can accept escrow monthly drawdowns — need the bank remit details and escrow agreement page that authorizes releases.

I'll attach a draft invoice template and a one-page matrix for procurement to review. If the schedule above looks OK to you we'll lock and send DocuSign 15 June.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Template_EU_v2.docx (invoice samples), MAP-Signature-Request.pdf (DocuSign stub)

From: Elena Cruz <ecruz@highton.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-06-12T11:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — invoice schedule & drawdown triggers (Highton)

Thanks Jonas — this is very helpful. A couple of quick clarifications from procurement and tax: 

- PO referencing: they require that Redwood invoices reference PO# 12345 and include cost-center 78-CC. Can you confirm invoice numbering can include the PO field?
- Amortization: we prefer the 6-month stagger option to avoid large quarter-end ECC impacts. Can you rework the tranche amounts to 25/25/25/25 spread across four dates starting 2028-07-01?
- Reverse-charge: Highton holds a UK VAT ID and an Irish entity for EU operations — we'll upload VAT certificates to the Drive link and provide the specific VAT IDs for each legal entity by EOD 13 June.

Finally, procurement would like the DocuSign envelope to include a separate box for billing contact signature (not just the legal signatory).

If you can send a revised invoice schedule and sample invoice with PO fields today that would be ideal.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: Highton_PO_12345.pdf (reference)

From: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Include PO# field, cost-center field, and our VAT id on header. We need PDF + Word versions. Target: EOD 14 June.
- Marissa: build a shared Google Sheet drawdown dashboard that will ingest monthly reconciliation CSVs. Columns: invoice_id, tranche_amount, drawdown_date, bank_ref, remaining_prepaid_credit. Add a permissions tab for Highton finance. Target: morning 14 June.
- Finance/tax question: if Highton supplies VAT certs for Ireland + UK, do we default to reverse-charge for intra-EU services or do we issue standard VAT with our registration? (Kim, loop in tax offline and add guidance in invoice footer.)
- Ops: add HubSpot note to deal DL-2028-0147 with invoice schedule and attach templates.

Hi Elena — attaching the requested templates and the updated schedule. Summary below: 

Finalized invoice schedule (per Highton request):
- Invoice 001: 2028-07-01 — 25% (reference PO# 12345; cost-center 78-CC)
- Invoice 002: 2028-10-01 — 25%
- Invoice 003: 2029-01-01 — 25%
- Invoice 004: 2029-04-01 — 25%

Drawdown / monthly reconciliation workflow:
- Highton submits monthly drawdown instructions to escrow (CSV).
- Redwood posts the drawdown confirmation within 24 hours and updates the shared reconciliation sheet.
- Final month-of-tranche reconciliation will be provided with invoice PDF.

VAT flow (based on certificates you will upload):
- If Highton provides EU VAT IDs + certificates, we will use reverse-charge and include customer VAT number on invoice footer.
- If any entity lacks valid EU VAT evidence, we will issue a standard VAT invoice and charge applicable VAT to the billed entity.

Attachments included:
- Redwood_Invoice_Template_EU_v2.docx (Word template — standard & reverse-charge variants)
- Redwood_Invoice_Sample_PO_12345.pdf (sample rendered invoice with PO fields populated)
- MAP-Signature-Request.pdf (DocuSign link inside — billing contact box added)

Next steps: please sign the DocuSign by 20 June and upload VAT certs to the Drive folder. Once signed we will issue Invoice 001 on 1 July.

If procurement wants a 6-month monthly amortization instead, let us know and we can provide a model.

Thanks,
